name: agentflow
description: Autonomous procurement layer for AI agents using x402 on Algorand

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
